Selected work

Three projects from different settings: an exhibition, a campus question desk, and an experiment in how agents use memory.

01

Rokid AR Guide

I led a small team building an exhibition guide for smart glasses. Visitors could identify an exhibit, hear a reviewed introduction, and ask follow-up questions.

I connected the Android camera pipeline to a Python service and worked on keeping answers tied to the exhibit in view. Recognition, exhibit switching, and introduction playback passed acceptance and regression checks.

Read the case study
Internship · 2026
02

AllAbout Campus

A hackathon project that helps students find answers across university pages and see the sources behind them.

I led the team and brought together the React interface, Fastify service, and live browser workflow. The result reports when a source is unavailable or does not provide enough evidence.

Read the case study
Hackathon · 2026
03

Memory Applicability Guard

An independent Python prototype that reviews whether an agent should use, ignore, or clarify a stored memory before acting on it.

The tool records its reason and the evidence behind it. The related experiment did not beat its baseline, a useful result that shaped the project's narrower scope.

Read the case study
Independent · 2026
04

FlowList

A playlist sequencing prototype. It imports public YouTube playlists or manual tracks, then uses track metadata to sketch mood chapters and transitions.
